main: ^What in the name of Hades was that?! It felt like I was turned inside out, run over by a chariot, and my remains torn apart by a thousand hounds!
^You're being dramatic. It wasn't that bad. One hound would’ve sufficed.
^You can’t. But your delightful mentor— me—can.
^Since when do you have that skill?
^Fine, it wasn’t exactly me. It was this little artifact I… borrowed from Chronos.
^Not at all! The fact that I used it amplifies its power. In your hands, it wouldn’t even work. And hey—I’m not a thief! I just borrowed it.
^Quite the excuse for a goddess of wisdom!
^Back to the point—you turned back time?
^Have you ever tried it on yourself? It’s disgusting and quite painful!
^Possibly. It depends on the strength of the reversal and how far back we went.
^Why do I remember everything? Is that dangerous?
^The artifact is set up for both of us, so only we retain memory. As for the risks… Well, let’s just say tampering with Chronos’ artifacts is like leaping off the cliff without a bottom.
^I’m starting to doubt you’re the goddess of wisdom…
^Also of strategy. And strategy implies risk. There's nothing you can do about it.
^You wanted to prove your strength to the gods! Working with me is your only chance. Trust me, no other god would take a mere mortal as their champion.
^Except you? Why are you doing this?
^Why do you need to know my goals?
^Is it because teamwork is based on trust?
^My one and only goal is to prove that my strategy can lead to victory—no matter the starting point! I want to see Zeus’ face when my champion, a mere mortal, defeats everyone in his path.
^Wow… So we do have similar goals. We both want to wipe that smirk off Zeus’ face.
